decisions.reason: These plug-ins sit squarely in the firm's core geospatial integration portfolio, had their own page, and as a modular product line are more likely to be updated than withdrawn.
A building digital twin service fits the firm's enterprise-oriented geospatial strategy well, but as a newer service with lighter website emphasis it still carries some commercialization risk.

Authentication and identity delegation remains strategically relevant for enterprise GIS deployments, though its proximity to the firm's other identity offerings creates a noticeable chance of consolidation.

An open GIS application development framework is a foundational offer that matches the firm's engineering strengths and is the kind of platform a medium-sized German specialist would usually sustain over time.
The identity and access service clearly supports seamless GeoIT integration and was explicitly launched, but some overlap with adjacent security products leaves a moderate bundling risk.

A geodata business process consulting workshop extends the firm's established consulting and training business naturally, and its dedicated page suggests enough strategic relevance to continue while the format is refined if needed.
